card.name: Lone H starting medical terms
card.fires_on: A lone letter H (often with a leading space, sometimes capitalised) that begins a longer medical word such as haptoglobin, hepatic, hematologic, hormone or HLA. Common in all-caps warning text.

modes.label: H in all-caps warnings
modes.description: Capital H starts a word like HEPATIC, HEMATOLOGIC or HAD in boxed warning text.
modes.example: FELBAMATE ORAL SUSPENSION SHOULD NOT BE PRESCRIBED FOR ANYONE WITH A HISTORY OF<< H>>EPATIC DYSFUNCTION.

card.writes: It promotes continuations such as 'apt' and 'EMA', which fit the rest of words like haptoglobin and hematologic.
card.plain: It fires when a word is split after its first letter H, such as hepatic or hematologic, and helps predict the rest.
